end.summary:
Practised turning observations into testable questions and predictions with reasons.
Identified steps in the finding-out cycle: observe, question, predict, test, conclude, ask again.
Suggested a fair test using two similar bowls, one warm and one cool.
Answered 3 of 4 question-forming attempts and 2 of 2 prediction attempts unaided.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the science process using examples about curd setting, drying, battery use, and bouncing. Neel used reasons for predictions and suggested keeping two bowls the same while changing only the temperature; they also connected the process to studying robots. The full cycle still needs another teach-back. At home, ask Neel to choose one everyday observation and say the question, prediction, and one fair test.
